name: EUR CoinVertible
oneLiner: EURCV is Societe Generale-FORGE's regulated euro stablecoin issued under the EU MiCA framework, designed for institutional on-chain settlement.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: EURCV retains its April 20, 2023 product launch. The issuer states that its restructuring into a MiCA electronic-money token took effect July 1, 2024 and removed transfer whitelisting. The contemporaneous EMT white paper gives holders a continuing Article 49 claim against the issuer and par euro redemption, with segregated accounts subject to Article 54 reserve investment rules. This replacement of the legal holder-claim and transfer/redemption framework is a material scored-mechanism boundary under D20; the implementation clock begins July 1, 2024, not on a later routine chain deployment or document update.

sources.label: SG-FORGE EURCV EMT restructuring effective July 1, 2024
Contemporaneous EURCV EMT white paper, June 28, 2024

collateral: Euro cash deposits at Societe Generale in segregated issuer accounts; the issuer's daily disclosure dated 2026-10-01 reports EURCV reserves 100% at Societe Generale.
pegMechanism: EEA-resident holders have 1:1 euro redemption rights through SG-FORGE after KYC/AML and sanctions controls; payment is due by the last business day of the following month after controls are completed. Non-EEA holders have no direct redemption right, and the issuer cannot transact with U.S. residents.
